the Kangwinan bauxite project that will support an expansion of its Weipa operations in Australia's Queensland state, which it said will sustain its position as one of the world’s leading high-quality bauxite producers.

said Kangwinan will replace production from the Andoom mine near Weipa as it reaches the end of its life this decade, while increasing Weipa's capacity to ~44M metric tons/year from current output of 38M tons/year and helping compensate for the planned end of production at the Gove mine in the Northern Territory in 2029.
The company also plans to expand the existing Amrun wharf to accommodate larger capesize vessels, improving supply-chain efficiency and reducing freight costs.
